title: Convert win/loss chart to bar graph and fix best streak calculation

requirements.summary: Convert ProfileWinLossChart from line chart to bar chart using Recharts BarChart and Bar components while preserving all filters, tooltips, and styling
acceptanceCriteria: The win/loss chart in ProfileWinLossChart.tsx renders as a bar chart instead of a line chart
Both wins and losses are represented as grouped or stacked bars
All existing time range filters (week, month, year, all-time) continue to work correctly
Axis labels, tooltips, and legend remain functional and visually consistent

file_operations.description: Replace LineChart and Line components with BarChart and Bar components from Recharts. Import BarChart and Bar instead of LineChart and Line. Update the chart rendering to use <BarChart> as the wrapper and <Bar dataKey="wins" ...> and <Bar dataKey="losses" ...> for the data series. Keep all existing ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, Legend, and time range filter logic unchanged. Preserve the existing color scheme (wins vs losses) and ensure bars are displayed side-by-side or stacked appropriately.

requirements.summary: Fix best streak calculation to track longest consecutive winning streak instead of cumulative total
acceptanceCriteria: The best streak value shown in the profile section reflects the longest consecutive winning streak, not a cumulative total
If a player has non-consecutive wins, only the longest unbroken run is counted
A player with zero wins shows a best streak of 0
The value updates correctly when new match history data is loaded

file_operations.description: Rewrite the best streak calculation logic in the ProfilePage component. Replace the current cumulative total approach with a new algorithm that: 1) sorts match history entries by date in chronological order, 2) iterates through the entries tracking consecutive wins, 3) resets the current streak counter whenever a loss is encountered, 4) maintains a variable for the maximum streak seen so far, and 5) returns the maximum consecutive streak count. Ensure the calculation handles edge cases: empty match history returns 0, and a single win returns 1. Update the display logic to show this corrected best streak value in the win/loss streaks section.
